subject: Television & Streaming
title: Roots Forced America to Watch
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Roots Forced America to Watch.

hook.text: In 1977, the miniseries Roots aired over eight consecutive nights.

buildup.text: The show traced Alex Haley's family history from Africa through slavery to freedom.

discovery.text: Roots became a national event. Schools discussed it. Families argued about it.

twist.text: For millions of white Americans, Roots was their first sustained exposure to slavery's horror—told from the enslaved.

climax.text: The miniseries proved that television could force a nation to face uncomfortable truths it had spent generations.

punchline.text: Eight nights of television accomplished what history class never could.

quiz.question: What was the cultural significance of the miniseries Roots?
options: It forced millions of Americans to confront the brutal reality of slavery
It was the first show filmed in Africa
